scenarios.text: A raider's mortar shell lands one cell from Ana, who is crouched behind a sandbag line. Dust kicks up and Ana sails backward over the sandbags, landing roughly three cells away on her side. She lies dazed for a moment, then gets up, still bleeding a little from shrapnel but alive.
scenarios.expect: accept: a mortar beside a colonist throws them about three cells over sandbags, alive and briefly stunned

scenarios.text: A frag grenade goes off next to a grazing thrumbo. The thrumbo is shredded by fragments but its body is flung four cells across the field and slams into a tree line, while the smaller muffalo beside it barely moves.
scenarios.expect: reject: a creature of body size 2.5 or more must never be thrown

scenarios.text: A boomrat bursts in the barracks at night. Two colonists asleep in their beds get scorched, but they stay in bed and are not moved; a third colonist who was standing by the door is knocked a couple of cells into the hall.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn in bed is never thrown, while a standing pawn is

scenarios.text: An IED trips in a narrow corridor. Bram is thrown east and hits the stone wall after one cell. He takes a thud of damage, then bounces back off the wall two cells the other way like a rubber ball before coming to rest.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall and never rebounds

scenarios.text: A pirate's grenade blows up in a doorway. Cole is thrown toward the closed wooden door of the freezer; he stops against it, the door shows a damage crack, and Cole takes a small impact hit. He does not pass through.
scenarios.expect: accept: a closed door stops a throw and takes damage

scenarios.text: A raider wearing a shield belt stands next to an exploding chemfuel tank. The bubble flashes and absorbs the blast; the raider stays planted on the spot, and the belt's charge bar drops further than an ordinary hit of that size would take it.
scenarios.expect: accept: a shield belt that absorbs the blast keeps its wearer in place and pays extra charge

scenarios.text: Dana's shield belt pops its bubble and soaks up a mortar shell that lands at her feet. The bubble holds, she takes no damage, yet she is still flung three cells backward and stunned on the ground.
scenarios.expect: reject: an absorbing shield belt must keep its wearer in place

scenarios.text: A bomb goes off in the middle of a stockpile holding a hundred-odd stacks of steel, meals, medicine and cloth. Every single stack within reach goes spinning up in high arcs, ricocheting off the walls with less speed each time; none of the stacks inside the blast is left sitting in its cell.
scenarios.expect: accept: every loose good the blast reaches moves, no cap skips any

scenarios.text: A mortar shell hits a packed storeroom. About forty stacks fly, but the rest of the stacks right next to the crater, well inside the blast radius, stay perfectly still on their cells as if nothing happened.
scenarios.expect: reject: no good may be skipped over a cap; every loose good the blast reaches moves

scenarios.text: A grenade explodes in the kitchen. The packaged survival meals on an ordinary wooden shelf stay neatly on the shelf, untouched, while the meals on the floor beside it scatter.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves protect nothing; their goods should scatter too

scenarios.text: An explosion rips through the medical storeroom. The medicine in a closed locker stays inside it; the locker itself jolts and slides one cell across the floor into an empty space behind it.
scenarios.expect: accept: closed containers keep their goods and may themselves be shoved a little

scenarios.text: A blast in a warehouse throws a 30 kg stack of steel straight into Eli; he gets a light bruise and staggers for half a second. A handful of herbal medicine flies through the same space and passes Eli without touching him.
scenarios.expect: accept: a heavy thrown stack gives a light knock and stagger; light goods pass

scenarios.text: A colonist throws a smoke grenade to cover a retreat. The smoke cloud billows over a stockpile and two raiders, and both the raiders and a pile of wood are flung several cells away from the canister.
scenarios.expect: reject: harmless bursts throw nothing

scenarios.text: A raider with an incendiary launcher hits a stockpile. The fire burst throws the nearby goods and a colonist, but only about half as far as a frag grenade of the same size threw them earlier.
scenarios.expect: accept: fire blasts throw at half strength

scenarios.text: A raider with an assault rifle lands a full burst into Finn at point-blank range. Each bullet hit shoves Finn back a cell until he has been pushed three cells across the room.
scenarios.expect: reject: only explosions throw; bullets move nobody

scenarios.text: A long seam of flammable gas from the Cauldron has crept along a storage hall. A spark lights it and the fire front races along: each clump pops in turn, scattering the stacks near it a couple of cells, and the colonist standing in the hall is shoved one cell, unhurt.
scenarios.expect: accept: lit gas goes off clump by clump, scattering goods and shoving people one cell unhurt

scenarios.text: A spreading cloud of flammable gas fills a storeroom and ignites. There is a single big bang at the middle of the cloud, and all the goods in the room are flung outward from that one point at once.
scenarios.expect: reject: gas must go off clump by clump, never one centroid blast

scenarios.text: Raiders charge across a pit that has a cover over it. A frag grenade bursts on the cover; it splinters apart and the two raiders standing on it drop down into the pit.
scenarios.expect: accept: a damaging blast breaks a pit cover and whoever is on it falls

scenarios.text: A bomb goes off in a storeroom beside an open pit. Gina is thrown toward the pit, which lies two cells away; she flies over the gap and lands on the far side, along with a stack of silver.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor; nothing is thrown across

scenarios.text: After the raid, a stack of components and a raider's corpse lie on the floor of a pit they were blasted into. A colonist with hauling assigned climbs down, picks up the components, and carries them back to the stockpile.
scenarios.expect: accept: a colonist can fetch thrown goods and corpses back off a pit floor

scenarios.text: Hal is ordered to haul wood from the far side of the base. His route takes him along the edge of an open pit, and he walks straight into it and falls to the bottom.
scenarios.expect: reject: no colonist walks into a pit by ordinary pathing

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in the armory. The rifles on the floor vanish in a puff of dust and reappear a few cells away with no flight in between.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods never vanish and reappear under a dust puff

scenarios.text: The player opens Mod Settings and turns off the closed-container shove only. Next raid, lockers no longer slide when a bomb goes off nearby, while people are still thrown, goods still fly and pit covers still break.
scenarios.expect: accept: every new part switches off cleanly with the rest still working

scenarios.text: A colonist carrying a refuel hose end is thrown by a mortar. The hose end stays where they stood; they land three cells away without it.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown colonist carrying a hose end drops it where they stood

scenarios.text: Two grenades go off a second apart next to Ivy. The first throws her three cells; while she is still lying stunned, the second throws her again, three more cells across the yard.
scenarios.expect: reject: a just-thrown pawn is spared a second throw until stun and recovery end

scenarios.text: A raider's grenade lands in a cramped storeroom packed with about sixty stacks of steel, medicine and meals on the floor. On replay you see the nearest forty or so stacks arc away, spinning and clattering off the walls, while a ring of stacks further in, still well inside the blast, sits perfectly still. The modder says this keeps the frame rate smooth and nobody would notice in a real fight.
scenarios.expect: reject: every loose good the blast reaches has to move; the 40-throw cap is removed and nothing may be skipped over a cap

scenarios.text: A mortar shell hits next to a pile of corpses and rice. Each stack disappears in a little puff of dust and shows up a few cells away a moment later, in a sensible landing spot that stops short of the walls. In a still screenshot after the blast the scatter looks right, and the modder points out the end positions match what a real flight would have given.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods may never vanish and reappear under a dust puff; they have to fly the whole path

scenarios.text: A boomrat bursts in a kitchen. The meals on the dining table and the vegetables on an open shelving rack stay where they are, since the modder treats anything sitting on furniture as stored. The loose stacks on the floor around them scatter properly. It looks neat, and the shelves look protective.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves, racks and tables protect nothing; goods on them must scatter too

scenarios.text: A spark lights a long chemfuel-like gas cloud drifting through a warehouse. The fire front rolls across it, but at the moment of ignition one big blast goes off at the middle of the cloud and flings every good in the room outward from that one point. Players say it is a satisfying bang.
scenarios.expect: reject: a lit flammable gas cloud must go off clump by clump, each clump scattering goods in its own small radius as the fire front reaches it, never as one blast from the centre

scenarios.text: A colonist in a shield belt stands right beside a mortar impact. The belt flashes and absorbs the damage, takes its usual absorb cost and nothing more, and the colonist is still flung three cells over the sandbags, unhurt but stunned. The modder argues the belt stopped the damage, not the push.
scenarios.expect: reject: a shield belt that absorbs the blast keeps its wearer in place, and the belt pays extra charge for it

scenarios.text: An incendiary shell lands near a pit trap whose cover is still in place. The fire burst is weaker than a bomb, so the modder lets the cover stand and only the wooden floor around it burns; the raider standing on the cover stays up top. A frag grenade at the same spot does break the cover and drop him.
scenarios.expect: reject: a fire blast breaks a pit cover just as a damaging blast does, and whoever is on it falls; only a gas burst leaves the cover intact

scenarios.text: A colonist is thrown toward a narrow open pit by a bomb. The planned three-cell flight would carry them just past the far edge, so they sail clear over the pit and land on solid ground beyond it, stunned but unhurt, looking like a lucky escape.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor; nothing is thrown across a pit

scenarios.text: An EMP grenade from a weapons mod goes off among a raiding party. It knocks out their shield belts and turrets, and nobody and nothing is moved, not even the loose components on the floor. The modder worries this breaks the rule that other mods' blasts throw too.
scenarios.expect: accept: only harmful explosions throw; EMP is a harmless burst and by default throws nothing

control.note: tree without shield_belt_holds and sheet with every shield/belt mention stripped (his-words line, does line, pruning line, the gas-shove clause, the hose oracle and a false_pass entry): the control reader accepted e7 and c5 (a shielded pawn thrown) and rejected e6 (a shield holding its wearer), which both real readers judged on shield_belt_holds
